name: Wiglett
description: Wiglett, the Garden Eel Pokémon. Able to evolve into Wugtrio. A Water type.
pokedex_entries: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.
Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation.
